title: Material Handler
description:
Pay Rate: $19.78/hr
Shift Timings: Monday - Friday 7:00am - 3:30pm Some weekend overtime may be required.

PRIMARY FUNCTION:
This position is responsible for the smooth, efficient flow of all raw material and fabricated material into, throughout, and out of the department.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
1. Issue material from stock location and kits material from daily release and pick list.
2. Prepare kits for transportation, deliver to dock area, and prepare appropriate packing list.
3. Deliver finished fabricated parts from machine area to the welding area, kitting area, interplant shipping docks, tagging pallets appropriately and staging them in the proper areas with pallet ID tags.

9. Receive, locate, and issue “daily release” parts daily to ensure proper inventory.
10. Dispose of all scrap steel into dumpsters outside of building. When dumpsters are ready to be shipped, make out scrap tickets and notify dispatcher, by telephone, at the scrap salvage company which dumpster to pick up.
11. Dispose of all scrap wood and interfaces with external vendors to always maintain empty hoppers for scrap wood disposal.
12. Move from raw material receiving and locating to WIP and finished goods receiving, locating, tagging, and movement throughout the day without interruption.
13. Deliver stand-up stackers and walkers for battery changes during the shift.

All applications must be US persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a US person as a US Citizen, US Permanent Resident (i.e. “Green Card Holder”), Political Asylee, or Refugee
